_readme: THE ONLY PLACE PRICES, STATS AND LINKS LIVE. Change a price here, run `node build.mjs`, commit. Prices must match the Stripe lookup_keys boomerang_core_monthly / boomerang_pro_monthly / boomerang_setup_fee (see README pre-launch checklist).

plans.name: Core
plans.tagline: Sara catches and qualifies every missed call. You close it.
features: Missed-call text-back in seconds, in your business name
AI intake: Sara asks the questions your trade needs
Emergency detection and instant owner / on-call paging
Customer photos straight to your thread
Answers your FAQs, English and Spanish
Qualified lead texted to you, ready to call
Inbox, voicemail playback, pause Sara on any thread

plans.name: Pro
plans.tagline: Everything in Core, plus Sara books the estimate on your calendar.
features: Books estimates straight onto Google Calendar
The Trust Dial™: autonomous, assisted, or assisted during business hours
Website “Request an estimate” button (one line of code)
Start new texts and call customers from the dashboard
Custom estimate windows and message templates

proof.label: Running on our own lawn care business, The Sod Squad, in its first year

stats.headline: of calls to small businesses were answered by a person
stats.detail: In a study of 85 small businesses, another 37.8% of calls went to voicemail and 24.3% got no answer at all. It is a small, older study, but it is the source of the widely quoted “62% go unanswered” figure.

stats.headline: of consumers leave a voicemail when a business doesn’t answer
stats.detail: The other 58% don’t. 21% immediately call another business.
stats.source: CallRail consumer survey, 1,000 U.S. adults, Sept 2025

stats.headline: have given up on a business after an unanswered call
stats.detail: And 82% say they would call a competitor if a business doesn’t pick up.
stats.source: CallRail consumer survey, 1,000 U.S. adults, Sept 2025

stats.headline: better odds of qualifying a lead contacted in 5 minutes vs. 30
stats.detail: Based on 15,000+ leads and 100,000+ call attempts across six companies. Contact odds were about 100× better.
stats.source: Lead Response Management Study, Oldroyd & Elkington (InsideSales.com / MIT), 2007

stats.headline: more likely to qualify a lead when you respond within an hour
stats.detail: Compared with waiting even one more hour, and 60× compared with waiting a day. 23% of the 2,241 companies audited never responded at all.
stats.source: Harvard Business Review, “The Short Life of Online Sales Leads,” 2011

industries.name: Tree Service
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Tree Service Companies
industries.description: Boomerang texts back every missed call, asks about tree size, structures and power lines, flags storm emergencies, and books the estimate while your crew is in the tree.
industries.hook: Every missed tree call is an $800 to $2,500 job you didn’t get.
industries.pain: You can’t answer a phone with a running saw. Storm weeks bring the most calls exactly when you’re busiest, and the homeowner with a limb on the roof calls the next company on Google.
questions: What do you need done, removal, trimming or stump grinding?
Roughly how tall is it, and is it near the house, a fence or power lines?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
industries.emergency: A tree just came down on our roof!
chat: Hi, I need a quote to take down a big pine in my backyard
Hi, this is Sara with Arbor View Tree Care. Sorry we missed your call! Happy to help with that. Roughly how tall is the pine, and is it close to the house or power lines?
Maybe 60 ft. It leans toward the garage
Got it. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Perfect, thanks! I have Thursday at 3:00 PM or Friday at 10:00 AM for an on-site estimate. Which works better?
You’re all set for Thursday at 3:00 PM. We’ll see you then!

industries.name: Lawn Care
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Lawn Care Companies
industries.description: Boomerang texts back missed calls while you mow, qualifies the property and service, checks your service area, and books the estimate. Built and run on a real lawn care business.
industries.hook: Every call that rings out while you’re on a mower is a season of mowing you didn’t sell.
industries.pain: Spring is when every homeowner calls at once, and it’s exactly when you’re behind the handlebars from sunup to sundown. Voicemail fills up and the callers book whoever answers first.
questions: Which service do you need, mowing, aeration, overseeding or cleanup?
How often, weekly, every other week or one time?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
chat: Hi, this is Sara with The Sod Squad. Sorry we missed your call! Yes, we do aeration. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Great. Would you like to add overseeding while we’re there, or just aeration?
Perfect, thanks! I can have someone out Tuesday at 4:00 PM or Wednesday at 5:00 PM to take a look. Which works?
You’re booked for Wednesday at 5:00 PM. See you then!

industries.name: Landscaping
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Landscapers and Hardscapers
industries.description: Boomerang texts back missed calls, gathers the project scope, address and timeline, and books the design consult or estimate. Big-ticket leads never sit in voicemail.
industries.hook: One missed patio call can be a $5,000 job. Most callers won’t leave a voicemail.
industries.pain: When you’re setting pavers or running a skid steer, the phone is in the truck. The homeowner planning a backyard project calls three companies and goes with the first one that gets back to them.
questions: What kind of project, planting, patio, retaining wall or full design?
Rough timeline, this season or next?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
chat: Looking to get a paver patio put in this spring
Hi, this is Sara with Greenline Landscapes. Sorry we missed your call! A patio sounds great. Roughly how big are you thinking?
Got it. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Thanks! I can set up a consult Monday at 9:00 AM or Tuesday at 2:00 PM. Which works?
You’re set for Monday at 9:00 AM. Talk soon!

industries.name: Pressure Washing
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Pressure Washing Businesses
industries.description: Boomerang texts back calls you miss while you’re on a wand, asks what surfaces need cleaning and the address, and books the quote so you can keep working.
industries.hook: You can’t hear the phone over a surface cleaner, and your callers won’t wait.
industries.pain: Most pressure washing calls are impulse calls. The homeowner sees a dirty driveway, searches, and calls down the list until someone answers. If it isn’t you, it’s a competitor.
questions: What needs cleaning, house, driveway, deck, roof or fence?
Is it a one-story or two-story home?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
chat: How much to wash my house and driveway?
Hi, this is Sara with Bright Side Exterior Cleaning. Sorry we missed your call! Happy to get you a quote. Is it a one-story or two-story home?
Got it. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Perfect, thanks! I can have someone stop by Thursday at 11:00 AM or Friday at 1:00 PM for a quick quote. Which works?
You’re all set for Friday at 1:00 PM!

industries.name: Pest Control
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Pest Control Companies
industries.description: Boomerang texts back missed calls, identifies the pest problem and urgency, checks your service area, and books the inspection. Recurring-revenue customers stop slipping away.
industries.hook: A homeowner who just saw a mouse isn’t leaving a voicemail. They’re calling the next number.
industries.pain: Pest calls are urgent and emotional. When techs are in crawl spaces and attics, calls go unanswered, and every one of those callers could have been a recurring quarterly customer.
questions: What are you seeing, ants, rodents, spiders, wasps or something else?
Where, inside the home, outside, or both?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
chat: We have mice in the garage, can someone come out?
Hi, this is Sara with Bug Busters Pest Control. Sorry we missed your call! We can help with that. Are you seeing signs inside the house too, or just the garage?
Got it. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Thanks! I can get a tech out tomorrow at 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM for an inspection. Which works?
You’re booked for tomorrow at 10:00 AM. We’ll see you then!

industries.name: Roofing
industries.title: Missed Call Text Back for Roofing Contractors
industries.description: Boomerang texts back every missed roofing call, gathers the problem, roof type and address, flags active leaks as emergencies, and books the inspection.
industries.hook: A single missed roof replacement call can cost you five figures.
industries.pain: After a storm, every homeowner on the block is calling. You’re on a roof, your office line is ringing out, and the first roofer to respond gets the inspection, and usually the job.
questions: Is this a leak, storm damage, or a replacement estimate?
Do you know roughly how old the roof is?
What’s the property address, including city and ZIP?
industries.emergency: Water is coming through our ceiling right now!
chat: Hail last night, I think we have roof damage
Hi, this is Sara with Summit Roofing. Sorry we missed your call! Sorry to hear that. Is water coming inside right now, or is it damage you can see from outside?
Got it. May I have your property address, including city and ZIP?
Thanks! I can get an inspector out Wednesday at 8:00 AM or 3:00 PM. Which works?
You’re set for Wednesday at 3:00 PM!
